prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1431; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change, with complaints of neck and back pain consistent with a strain mechanism. The reported symptoms align well with the nature and force of the impact described. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion, while neurological screening, reflexes, and motor strength remained within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical or lumbar regions is known to this provider. Care consisted of ten visits including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction, following a conventional course of conservative management. Symptoms improved steadily over the treatment period, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as function returned. Billed services correspond to the documented visits, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. Patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
